email.subject: Gentle Dentistry's site is likely losing new patients
email.body:
Hi Grace,

I checked Gentle Dentistry's website and two things stood out. There are no patient reviews shown, which matters a lot for dental sites since most people compare a few practices before booking and pick the one that looks trusted. The homepage title also doesn't mention "dentist" or "Harbor Falls," so you're likely missing people searching those terms on Google.

I fix issues like this for local businesses for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's costing you patients?

Alex
Northlight Web
